content: Documentation frameworks (training knowledge; canonical, not live-verified this run): Datasheets for Datasets (Gebru et al., CACM 2021) — motivation, composition, collection, preprocessing, uses, distribution, maintenance; Model Cards (Mitchell et al. 2019); Data Statements for NLP (Bender & Friedman 2018); Dataset Nutrition Labels; NeurIPS Datasets & Benchmarks track requires structured docs + reproducibility info; MLCommons Croissant machine-readable metadata adopted by HF; Hugging Face model/dataset cards are the de-facto implementation; Data Provenance Initiative found widespread license misattribution in ML corpora. For a benchmark with 50 datasets, per-dataset provenance (source, license, citation, preprocessing) is the expected documentation surface.
